title: Open-immersion direct images
statement:
Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be an
open immersion of
finite-type schemes over a field $k$, and let $F$ be a finite
constructible
$\Lambda$-sheaf with the prime-to-characteristic finite
coefficients of this blueprint.
Every higher direct image
$R^qj_*F$ is constructible, and they vanish for all sufficiently
large $q$. For $q>0$ their restrictions to $U$ vanish.

proof.text: Convert the given finite-constant-value constructibility of F to the source-library finite-stalk predicate using [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-etale-module-sheaf-comparison]. The proved DerivedCategory.boundedConstructible_singleFunctor_obj gives constructible cohomology of F[0]. Its standard t-structure bounds are both zero, so its cohomology vanishes outside [0,0]. Converting constructibility back gives the exact bounded-constructible predicate of [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes].

Apply [cor-fin-deligne-open-finite-coefficients] to F[0], with aY the given structure morphism of X and the unchanged coefficient hypothesis [sbc-def-coefficient-conventions]. Unpack its conclusion: the first component proves constructibility in every degree, and the upper endpoint b of the finite cohomology interval proves vanishing for q>b.

For the restriction assertion use the already proved source-library support clause of this same blueprint theorem, AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.isZero_upperStar_homology_rightDerivedLowerStar_singleFunctor in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.Etale.Derived.Finiteness.DirectImage. It applies to every module sheaf and q unequal to zero. Its proof computes the derived direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] on a K-injective representative; the module-valued fully faithful pushforward [lem-sc-open-immersion-pushforward-fully-faithful] gives the invertible counit termwise. The exact upperStar functor commutes with homology through mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso, identifying the restriction with the cohomology of F[0]. The latter is zero away from degree zero by the standard t-structure. Apply this proved clause with q>0, hence q unequal to zero. No comparison with the separate SheafOfModules encoding is needed.

lean.statement: theorem openImmersion_higherDirectImages_constructible_vanishing (k : Type u) [Field k] (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ] (N : ℕ) (hΛ : IsSmoothBaseChangeCoefficients N Λ (Spec (.of k))) {U X : Scheme.{u}} [U.Over (Spec (.of k))] [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (U ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (U ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] (j : U ⟶ X) [j.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [IsOpenImmersion j] (F : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (hF : Scheme.IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf F) : (∀ q : ℤ, Scheme.IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf ((_root_.DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj ((rightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j).obj ((_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)))) ∧ (∃ b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, b < q → IsZero ((_root_.DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj ((rightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j).obj ((_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)))) ∧ (∀ q : ℤ, 0 < q → IsZero ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j).obj ((_root_.DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj ((rightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j).obj ((_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)))))
